claims.text: After transurethral resection: instillation of chemo (mitomycin-C and gemcitabine) within 24 hours reduces recurrences
claims.quote: Postoperative instillation of chemotherapeutic agents (mitomycin-C and gemcitabine) within 24 hours has been shown to reduce recurrences.

claims.text: Carcinoma in situ and other high-grade non-muscle-invasive CA: intravesical BCG instillations (or radical cystectomy)
claims.quote: Carcinoma in situ and other high-grade nonmuscle-invasive urothelial carcinomas are treated with Bacille Calmette-Guérin (BCG) intravesical instillations or radical cystectomy (1).

claims.text: Invasive: neoadjuvant cisplatin-containing chemo before cystectomy = standard of care in eligible pts
claims.quote: Neoadjuvant chemotherapy with a cisplatin-containing regimen prior to cystectomy is considered standard of care in eligible patients.

claims.text: After radical cystectomy: adjuvant cisplatin-based chemo (if no neoadjuvant tx), or adjuvant nivolumab if significant residual dz despite neoadjuvant chemo or can't tolerate cisplatin-based chemo
claims.quote: Following radical cystectomy, patients should be considered for adjuvant cisplatin-based chemotherapy (if they did not receive neoadjuvant therapy) or for adjuvant nivolumab if they have significant residual disease despite neoadjuvant chemotherapy or cannot tolerate cisplatin-based chemotherapy.

claims.text: Metastases: systemic tx, generally cisplatin-based chemo or enfortumab vedotin/pembrolizumab; frequently effective but rarely curative unless mets are confined to lymph nodes
claims.quote: Metastases require systemic therapy, generally either cisplatin-based chemotherapy (gemcitabine/docetaxel or MVAC [methotrexate, vinblastine sulfate, doxorubicin hydrochloride (Adriamycin), and cisplatin]) or combination immunotherapy/antibody-drug conjugate (enfortumab vedotin/pembrolizumab), which is frequently effective but rarely curative unless metastases are confined to lymph nodes.

claims.text: Chemo upfront: can be followed by maintenance immunotherapy w avelumab
claims.quote: If treated with chemotherapy upfront, patients can be followed by maintenance immunotherapy with avelumab.
